caveats: ⚑ skill1 trigger: the engine has no self-status gate, so 'while not in Missile Guide status' is approximated by re-applying the Missile Guide buffs on EVERY shot (shotFired) with durationShots:3 + removeOnReload. With ammo 8 and a 3-round window the faithful gate also yields ~100% in-magazine uptime (rounds 1-3 / 4-6 / 7-8, cleared at reload), so the approximation should be damage-equivalent; it diverges only if the engine's shot cadence lets the 3-round window lapse mid-magazine.

⚑ skill1 'Full Charge attack' is keyed to shotFired on the assumption the sim always fires RL shots at full charge. If partial-charge shots exist in the engine, shotFired over-counts both the Missile Guide refresh and the skill2 266.6% rider.

⚑ skill2 ATK ▲20% (Battle Formation) is NOT modeled — the gating status is never granted by this kit and the schema has no self-status gate; modeling it ungated would grant a near-permanent 20% ATK. Under-credits if the status is externally supplied.

⚑ skill2 Projectile Explosion Damage ▲20% is encoded behind requiresTargetStatus:'Explosive Round'. No unit in this kit inflicts that status, so the block is currently INERT by design rather than dropped.
⚑ Rider crit: the 266.6% and 492.3% true-damage hits are authored crit:true per the rider convention (riders crit at the caster's rate, no core). Unverified for true-flavored damage on this unit.
⚑ Burst block ordering assumes the self True Damage ▲60% resolves before the 492.3% burst nuke, so the nuke benefits from it. Not stated by the kit text.
